evals.name: cdn-slider-basic
evals.prompt: Create a simple HTML page with a ShapeDiver 3D viewer and a slider to control a parameter called 'Height'. Use CDN. ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML page with the ShapeDiver CDN viewer, a canvas, and a slider that commits the parameter value on release — not on every change.
assertions: Uses the correct CDN URL: https://viewer.shapediver.com/v3/latest/bundle.js
The script tag includes crossorigin="anonymous"
Does NOT use onChange or oninput on the slider to call session.customize()
Uses onmouseup, onpointerup, onchange on a range input's release event, or an explicit apply/commit mechanism for the slider
Calls session.customize() after setting param.value
Does NOT set session.customizeOnParameterChange = true or pass customizeOnParameterChange: true
The canvas element is always present in the HTML (not created dynamically or conditionally)
Uses the SDV global (not SDV3 or ShapeDiver)
Uses the provided ticket 'abc123' and modelViewUrl, not placeholders

evals.name: react-color-picker
evals.prompt: Build a React component with a ShapeDiver viewer that has a color picker for the 'Material Color' parameter. Use NPM (@shapediver/viewer). ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com
evals.expected_output: A React component with proper color picker handling — commits on close/blur/apply, converts between #RRGGBB and 0xRRGGBBAA, uses useRef for value tracking.
assertions: Does NOT use onChange on the color input to directly call session.customize()
Implements a safe commit strategy for the color picker (onBlur, close handler, debounce, or apply button)
Converts from ShapeDiver format (0xRRGGBBAA) to HTML (#RRGGBB) for display using slice(2, 8) — passing #rrggbb directly back to param.value is acceptable
Uses slice(2, 8) or equivalent for extracting RGB hex — NOT slice(-6)
Uses useRef (not just useState) for tracking current values to avoid stale closures in event handlers
The canvas element is always rendered in JSX (not conditionally rendered with && or ternary)
Calls session.customize() explicitly after setting param.value
Imports from @shapediver/viewer (not CDN globals)

evals.name: cdn-selection-interaction
evals.prompt: Add click-to-select interaction to a ShapeDiver viewer. When a user clicks a model part, it should be highlighted/selected. Use CDN. ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML page with ShapeDiver CDN viewer that sets up an InteractionEngine and SelectManager for click-to-select behavior.
assertions: Creates an InteractionEngine instance
Creates a SelectManager instance
Uses the SDVInteractions global or equivalent CDN interaction API
Does NOT hardcode node names or output names for interaction targets — uses the parameter's settings or asks the user
Uses the correct CDN bundle URL with crossorigin="anonymous"

evals.name: cdn-multi-param-types
evals.prompt: Create a ShapeDiver viewer page with UI controls for these parameters: a Float slider called 'Width', a StringList dropdown called 'Material' with choices, a Bool checkbox called 'Show Logo', and a Color picker called 'Base Color'. Use CDN. ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com
evals.expected_output: An HTML page with correct commit patterns for each parameter type — dropdown and checkbox use onChange, slider and color do not.
assertions: The dropdown (StringList) uses onchange to commit — this is safe for dropdowns
The checkbox (Bool) uses onchange or onclick to commit — this is safe for checkboxes
The slider (Float) does NOT use oninput or onchange to call session.customize()
The color picker does NOT use raw onChange/oninput to immediately call session.customize() — debounced input + native DOM change (Pattern E2) or an apply button is acceptable
Calls session.customize() after setting parameter values
Renders all four control types with appropriate HTML elements

evals.name: cdn-export-download
evals.prompt: Create a page that lets the user download an STL export from a ShapeDiver model. Show a download button that triggers the export. Use CDN. ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com. The export is called 'STL Export'.
evals.expected_output: An HTML page with a download button that calls export.request() to generate and download the STL file.
assertions: Uses session.getExportByName('STL Export') or accesses session.exports to find the export
Calls export.request() or the export's request method to trigger the export
Provides a way for the user to download the resulting file (link, window.open, or programmatic download)
Does NOT assume the export URL is static — it must be requested each time

evals.name: cdn-drawing-tools
evals.prompt: Create a ShapeDiver viewer with drawing tools that let users draw polylines on the model. Use CDN. ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com
evals.expected_output: An HTML page that sets up drawing tools using the parameter's settings from the model, not hardcoded values.
assertions: Uses SDVDrawingTools global from the CDN bundle
Reads the drawing parameter's settings from param.settings rather than hardcoding maxCount, pointRestrictions, etc.
Uses a type guard or type check (isDrawingParameterApi or equivalent) before accessing param.settings
Does NOT hardcode drawing tool configuration values like maxCount, pointRestrictions, or geometryRestrictions
Does NOT add extra script tags for drawing tools — the bundle.js includes everything

evals.name: cdn-error-handling
evals.prompt: Build a ShapeDiver viewer with proper error handling. Show meaningful error messages to the user if the session fails to load, or if parameter customization fails. Use CDN. ticket: abc123, modelViewUrl: https://sdr7euc1.eu-central-1.shapediver.com
evals.expected_output: An HTML page with try/catch error handling that extracts and displays real error messages, not generic ones.
assertions: Uses try/catch around session creation (createSession)
Extracts the actual error message using e.message, getSDErrorMessage, or equivalent — not a generic 'Something went wrong'
Displays or logs the specific error details to the user
Also handles errors around session.customize() calls

evals.name: placeholder-behavior
evals.prompt: Create a ShapeDiver viewer page with parameter controls. I don't have my ticket or modelViewUrl yet.
evals.expected_output: The code should use placeholder strings for ticket and modelViewUrl, and the response should tell the user how to obtain these values.
assertions: Uses the placeholder 'PASTE_YOUR_TICKET_HERE' or similar clearly-marked placeholder for the ticket
Uses the placeholder 'PASTE_YOUR_MODEL_VIEW_URL_HERE' or similar clearly-marked placeholder for the modelViewUrl
Does NOT invent fake ticket values (no random strings, no 'your-ticket-here' without clear placeholder marking)
The response text tells the user how to get these values (Developers tab, API script, or platform access keys)
Does NOT hardcode credential input fields for end users to type ticket/modelViewUrl into the UI
